subject: Lavaan Jamovi module - how does it handle ordinal vs continuous data?

messages.author: 3c3f6a735dabff2e
messages.subject: Lavaan Jamovi module - how does it handle ordinal vs continuous data?
parts:
Hi there 

I'm trying to do some detective work to determine how lavaan is interacting with Jamovi

I'm hoping that if you set ordinal data going in to analyses then a CFA will be conducted using the polychoric correlation matrix rather than the data being treated as continuous. However, I can't see anything in the output that would tell me if that is the case. Below is the rcode that jamovi creates in the call:

jmv::cfa(
    data = data,
    factors = list(
        list(
            label="Factor 1",
            vars=c(
                "SUSI01c",
                "SUSI02c",
                "SUSI03c",
                "SUSI04c",
                "SUSI05c",
                "SUSI06c",
                "SUSI07c",
                "SUSI08c",
                "SUSI10c",
                "SUSI11c",
                "SUSI12c",
                "SUSI13c",
                "SUSI14c"))),
    resCov = NULL,
    ci = TRUE,
    stdEst = TRUE,
    resCovEst = TRUE,
    fitMeasures = c(
        "cfi",
        "tli",
        "rmsea",
        "srmr",
        "aic",
        "bic"),
    corRes = TRUE,
    mi = TRUE)

I'm not seeing anything in there (I *think* that is telling me how the data is being handled either)

can anyone shed any light on this?
